summary: Invokes the virtual notification callback at obj+0x2C (vtable slot offset +44) with argument 1, decrements the counter at this+0x14C by the step at this+0x164, clamps it to a minimum of 0, then refreshes visual state via sub_489D00 and FloatToIntConversion. Always returns 0.

local_names.this: UI list/scroll object carrying the counter at 0x14C and the step at 0x164
local_names.obj: base carrying the virtual callback pointer at +0x2C
local_names.v2: raw decremented counter value before clamping

operations.description: Read the vtable pointer at this+0x0, index the virtual callback at offset +44 (obj+0x2C) and invoke it on this with argument 1 (notification/change handler).
v2 = this[83] - this[89]: counter at this+0x14C decremented by the step size at this+0x164.
Write the decremented value v2 back to the counter at this[83] (this+0x14C).
Clamp the counter at this+0x14C to a minimum of 0: when v2 is negative it is set to 0.
sub_489D00 refreshes the scroll list visual state from the updated counter.
FloatToIntConversion converts the internal float position to an integer representation.

unresolved: The virtual callback invoked at offset +44 (obj+0x2C) is a change/notification handler, but the object identity of the obj base and the callback's side effects are unknown.
The parameter contracts of sub_489D00 and FloatToIntConversion beyond taking this are not documented in this packet.
